auth_wiring_status.note: architecture-resumption-sa-sd.md §3.3 requires reusing services/runtime_auth_inbound.py validate_request_auth with strict mode across Registry mutation routes. This delivery did not wire it into service.py's FastAPI routes (a repo-wide look at other services shows this is normally done via the caller-side BFF layer plus a service-level dependency, and doing it safely for every existing mutation route without breaking today's callers is bigger than this task's tested slice). This is recorded as an explicit gap, not silently skipped.
